InvestorLiftAPIKeyCredential.title: InvestorLift API Key
InvestorLiftAPIKeyCredential.x-credential-instructions: Create an API key in the InvestorLift Data Services portal and paste it here. NoClick sends it as a Bearer token to api.investorliftdata.com. The free coverage read checks key acceptance; it does not identify your account. Valuation and most data requests spend your InvestorLift balance.

address.description: The full street address of the property to score.
address.title: Address

condition.description: The property's condition, which sets the repair budget the derived numbers are built on. Optional: omit it and the property is priced as though it needs no repairs, which is exactly what `turn_key` does. It is a request option rather than a second property, so sending it never changes what the call costs.
condition.title: Condition

rehab_budget.description: Your own repair budget for this property, in **whole dollars**. Optional, and additive: an integration that does not send it is unaffected.
rehab_budget.title: Rehab Budget

target_margin.description: The profit margin your buyer needs, as a **fraction** of the repaired value — `0.2` means twenty percent. Optional, and additive: an integration that does not send it is unaffected, and is priced at the default of `0.2`.
target_margin.title: Target Margin

overrides.description: Price the property **as you describe it**, not as the county record has it. Optional, and additive: an integration that does not send it is unaffected and its answers do not move.

square_feet.description: Finished living area, in **square feet**. Must be above zero.
square_feet.title: Square Feet

bedrooms.description: Bedroom count. Zero or above; `0` is accepted, because a studio genuinely has none.
bedrooms.title: Bedrooms

bathrooms.description: Bathroom count, as the property data service counts them. Zero or above, and **may be fractional** — `2.5` is ordinary. It does not include `partial_bathrooms`, which stays at the county's figure and is not overridable; this service does not add the two together.
bathrooms.title: Bathrooms

year_built.description: Year the structure was built. Must be above zero.
year_built.title: Year Built

lot_size_square_feet.description: Lot size, in **square feet** — never acres. Must be above zero. This is one of the facts the valuation requires, so supplying it can make a property scorable that the county record alone could not score.
lot_size_square_feet.title: Lot Size Square Feet

property_type.description: Property type, as free text. Must not be blank or only spaces; surrounding spaces are trimmed, exactly as the county record's own value is, so the trimmed value is what appears in `subject_property.facts`. This is one of the facts the valuation requires, so supplying it can make a property scorable that the county record alone could not score.
